title: The General opinion in the town
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：general　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 general 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the warden wrote of ① a general opinion in the town in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② more general than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the general ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most general opinion in the town anybody in the centre had ever seen, or so the register for June 1944 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too general to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the general ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a general rule for the school, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as general as the rule for the school they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was general or not, and he said so.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something general, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite general; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the general ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960, at once, she wrote of another general opinion in the town in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more general than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most general rule for the school in the whole centre, she said in 1962, was the one she could never quite name; the general ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 普遍（前置定语 a general opinion in the town：1950 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件普遍的看法）
B. adj. 普遍／总（比较级 more general than：文中两处，一处比镇上的普遍看法，一处比预想）
C. adj. 普遍／总（最高级 the most general：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 普遍（表语 too general to do：母亲觉得它太普遍，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 总（前置定语 a general rule for the school：叔叔把整件事称作一桩总的体规矩）
F. adj. 总（同级比较 as general as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学校的总体规矩相比）
G. adj. 总（后置定语 something general：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 总（受程度副词修饰 quite general：那位居民的评价）

items.q: a general opinion in the town
the most general opinion in the town anybody
a general rule for the school
The most general rule for the school in

answers.why: general 意为“普遍”，1950 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件普遍的看法”，此处作前置定语 a general opinion in the town。
general 意为“普遍”，此处用比较级 more general than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
general 意为“普遍”，登记册上 六月 那行字说它是社区中心里最普遍的一件，故用最高级 the most general opinion in the town。
general 意为“普遍”，母亲认为这件东西“太普遍了，谁也用不上”，too general to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
general 意为“总”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩总的体规矩”，此处作前置定语 a general rule for the school。
general 意为“总”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学校的总体规矩一样总”，同级比较用 as general as。
general 意为“总”，登记册上那半行字要的是“总的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something general。
general 意为“总”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当总”，quite 修饰原级 general。
general 意为“总”，1960 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要总”，故用比较级 more general than。
general 意为“总”，母亲 1962 年说的是“整个社区中心里最总的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most general rule for the school。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件普遍的看法。（a general opinion in the town）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更普遍。（more general than …）
母亲觉得它太普遍，谁也用不上。（too general to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩总的体规矩。（a general rule for the school）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学校的总体规矩一样总。（as general as …）
到了 1957 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件总的东西。（something general）
answers: In 1950 the warden wrote of a general opinion in the town in the register.
Everybody said it was more general than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too general to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a general rule for the school.
He said nobody would call it as general as the rule for the school they had once had.
By 1957 the register asked for nothing but something general.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 general 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the warden wrote of a general opinion in the town in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most general opinion in the town in the centre, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too general to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a general rule for the school, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite general, and everybody laughed.
The general ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
